verification.method: Hand-curated against the official DeepSeek thinking-mode contract (api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode): chat completions accept thinking {type: enabled|disabled} plus reasoning_effort {low, high, max}. The relay forwards the request body to DeepSeek. Levels map to the nearest supported effort — a same-name map would forward an invalid "medium" — and off: null keeps an unset level at the provider default instead of silently disabling thinking.
verification.result: Effort vocabulary is documented, not probed: the relay is user-configured, so values are taken from the official API contract.
